# `patterns/onboarding`

A checklist tracks setup tasks the user completes over time.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A checklist tracks setup tasks the user completes over time.
- **Avoid when:** The steps are one linear flow with a current position.
- **Consider instead:** `patterns/timelines`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { Checklist } from "themelia-ui/patterns/onboarding"
import "themelia-ui/patterns/onboarding.css"
```

## Composition

This module composes `base/accordion`, `base/display`, `base/feedback`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

({ steps, defaultExpanded, expanded: expandedProp, onExpandedChange, onStepOpen, multiple, surface, strings, className, ...props }: ChecklistProps) => import("react").JSX.Element

### `ChecklistProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `Omit<ComponentProps<"div">, "children" | "onChange" | "defaultValue">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `steps` | yes | `ChecklistStep[]` | id, status, title, and optionally badge, content, disabled. |
| `defaultExpanded` | no | `string[]` | Uncontrolled starting state. Defaults to the first unfinished step. |
| `expanded` | no | `string[]` | The open steps, controlled. Uncontrolled, the checklist opens the first unfinished<br>step. |
| `onExpandedChange` | no | `(expanded: string[]) => void` | Reports the open steps when a reader opens or closes one. |
| `onStepOpen` | no | `(id: string) => void` | Fires on the transition into open — for analytics, not for state. |
| `multiple` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `surface` | no | `AccordionSurface` |  |
| `strings` | no | `Partial<ChecklistStrings>` |  |

### Onboarding checklist

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
import { Badge } from "themelia-ui/base/badge"
import { Button } from "themelia-ui/base/buttons"
import { Stack } from "themelia-ui/base/structure"
import { Text } from "themelia-ui/base/typography"
import { Checklist } from "themelia-ui/patterns/onboarding"

export default function BlocksChecklist() {
	return (
		<Checklist
			steps={[
				{ id: "1", status: "completed", title: "Create your workspace", content: <Text type="secondary">Named and provisioned in eu-west-1.</Text> },
				{ id: "2", status: "completed", title: "Invite your team", content: <Text type="secondary">Four people accepted.</Text> },
				{
					id: "3",
					status: "inProgress",
					title: "Connect a data source",
					badge: <Badge tone="warning">Required</Badge>,
					content: (
						<Stack gap="md">
							<Text type="secondary">Pick where your data lives. You can add more later.</Text>
							<Stack direction="horizontal" gap="sm" wrap>
								<Button tone="primary">Connect Postgres</Button>
								<Button tone="secondary" buttonStyle="outline">Upload a CSV</Button>
							</Stack>
						</Stack>
					),
				},
				{ id: "4", status: "pending", title: "Publish your first dashboard", content: <Text type="secondary">Start from a template.</Text> },
			]}
		/>
	)
}
```
